chatwoot._comment: CRM 客服台（add-crm-desk-bridge/add-crm-desk-pack-embed）：npm dist 即上游官方 bun --target node 单文件 bundle，node 直跑零本地构建。双凭据形态：部署 env（requiresEnv+envRefs，机器 owner/寻数 A 租户）或逐用户 BYOK（credentialEnv→chatwoot ref，已认证用户须自连凭据否则条目省略，见 dsh-profile toMcpClientEntry）。工具面上界（98 标准面）见 lib/operator-tool-face.js。

websearch._comment: envRefs name (never hold) the relay env pair — dsh's subprocess scrub strips TOKEN-shaped names from MCP children, so the pair is forwarded explicitly at patch-write time. Both unset ⇒ web_search degrades to an explicit not-configured error. SEARCH_USER_KEY (add-search-byok) is the user's OWN key: optional by design — its absence is the normal state, not a degradation.

fleet-architect._comment: 舰队架构师工具面(agent-fleet-architect):读态/草稿/落地三段五工具,bundled 种子自激活,loopback 桥身份=cell owner

playwright._comment: 浏览器操作车道（add-browser-use-lane）：first-party 薄启动器拉起钉版 @playwright/mcp（headless；BROWSER_CDP_ENDPOINT 时 attach 远程浏览器）。laneGate=browser 供给门在 patch 生成期裁决：无本地 runtime（BROWSER_RUNTIME_PATH 不存在）且无远程端点、或 BROWSER_LANE=off ⇒ 整条省略（requiresEnv 省略同族，info 日志）。工具名 mcp__playwright__*，走既有 tool 渲染链。
